```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(multcomp)

```

```{r}

studs <- read.csv("C:/Users/Max Byrne/OneDrive - Minnesota State/Desktop/School/Spring 2025/STAT301/Project/StudentPerformanceFactors.csv")

studs2 <- studs%>%
  filter(Teacher_Quality != "")

studs2$Teacher_Quality <- factor(studs2$Teacher_Quality, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"))
studs2$Motivation_Level <- factor(studs2$Motivation_Level, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"))


model <- aov(Exam_Score ~ Motivation_Level + Teacher_Quality + Motivation_Level * Teacher_Quality, data = studs2)

cat("\n\nANOVA Table for Model:")
cat("\n=========================================================================\n")
summary(model)

Tukey <- TukeyHSD(model)

cat("\n\nTukeyHSD Results for Motivation Level:")
cat("\n=======================================================\n")
Tukey$Motivation_Level
cat("\n\nTukeyHSD Results for Teacher Quality:")
cat("\n======================================================\n")
Tukey$Teacher_Quality

interaction.plot(studs2$Teacher_Quality, studs2$Motivation_Level, studs2$Exam_Score, fun = mean, xlab = "Teacher Quality", ylab = "Mean Exam Score", 
                 main = "Interaction Between Motivation Level and Teacher Quality", trace.label = "Motivation Level", col = c("red", "green", "blue"))

```
